# macOS Desktop Simulator

> A macOS desktop simulator built with React and TypeScript by Dawid Olko. It runs in the browser with a login screen, a dock, draggable windows, a menu bar and a set of working demo applications.

## Pages

- [Home](https://macos.dawidolko.pl/): the simulated desktop

## Author

- [Dawid Olko](https://dawidolko.pl): Fullstack / AI Developer, author of this project
